lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four primary horizontal tiers of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. The centroids are arranged in a staggered grid pattern with local maxima showing increased spacing towards the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots at approximately 90-degree angles, forming a lattice of high-luminance anchor nodes, most clearly defined in the mid-lateral zone.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (high luminance on the superior edge, shadow on the inferior edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs is visible across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration observed near the base and leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. No other major physical trauma or lesions are detectable.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity caustic light patterns from surface water refraction are overlaid across the dorsal and lateral surfaces, creating a secondary network of wavy, high-luminance lines.
